purpose: The exhaustive list of Unit 202 evidence-authority-policy decisions that are genuinely, externally recorded as real Product Architect decisions (not self-declared by an acquisition/correction pass). Any `paAuthorityPolicyAdjudication` object embedded in a Batches 04-06 EVIDENCE-RESULTS.json row must have an `id` present in this registry's `decisions` array, or it is treated as an ungoverned, ad hoc field and must be removed or reclassified. This registry itself must never be edited to retroactively legitimise a field found during validation -- a new entry may only be added when a genuine, externally-recorded Product Architect decision actually exists (e.g. a PROJECT-STATUS.md entry, a DECISION-LOG.md entry, or equivalent).

structuralPolicyNote: Unit 202's genuine, code-enforced widening of the OPERATIONAL_USE_RULE mode (UNIT202_SOURCE_AUTHORITY_POLICY in scripts/backtests/unit202-evidence-acquisition-preflight/unit202-adapter.ts) is NOT modelled as a per-row paAuthorityPolicyAdjudication object at all -- it is baked directly into the frozen evidence-requirement plan's own sourceAuthorityClasses field for exactly Unit 202's three OPERATIONAL_USE_RULE targets (the right-hand grip rule and the two Fleming rules), enforced by a fail-closed invariant (assertUnit202DirectionalRuleInvariant) that refuses planning if the premise (exactly 3 targets, exactly the same dimension set) ever breaks.
